display.purpose: The h1 in the mission strip — once per screen, compressed (wdth 112).

stamp.purpose: The Acquire button — the only place Archivo goes loud (700, wdth 110, uppercase).

body.purpose: Sentence prose: tagline, error copy. Base body size.

label.purpose: Control labels, Skip button, source link, legend names, field hints. Uppercase mono.

micro-label.purpose: Module nomenclature: rack section labels, truth chips, legend summary. Uppercase mono, 500.

readout.purpose: Amber slider readouts, pass-line, probe reading, fallback input — the live measurement voice.

seed-field.purpose: Typed telemetry — the seed input, the largest mono on screen.

shadows.name: probe-halo
shadows.purpose: Functional legibility scrim under the probe's foam crosshair lines and reticle so they read on bright biomes. The system's only shadow; never for elevation.

motion.name: chrome-settle
motion.purpose: State transitions on interactive chrome (background-color, border-color, color). Nothing slower in the chrome.

motion.name: led-pulse
motion.value: led-pulse 1.1s ease-in-out infinite (50% keyframe at opacity 0.3)
motion.purpose: Busy signal on the pass-line LED while bands acquire — driven by #stage:has(#map-canvas[aria-busy='true']); degrades to a steady LED where :has is unsupported.

motion.name: dice-tumble
motion.purpose: One-shot die tumble on seed roll (full turn with a small hop) — the rack's only authored glyph moment.

motion.name: reduced-motion-guard
motion.purpose: Global guard: every animation and transition above stops. The staged canvas reveal has its own JS-side bypass.

components.name: Acquire Stamp
components.description: The one amber fill per screen — the primary action, anchored in the rack's Acquire module.
components.css: .ds-acquire-stamp { font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 700; font-stretch: 110%; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent-ink); background: var(--accent); border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 2px; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-acquire-stamp:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent-bright); border-color: var(--accent-bright); } .ds-acquire-stamp:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent-bright); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-acquire-stamp:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Cut-out well button for presets, Export PNG, Copy link — hover spends the amber edge, never a fill.
components.css: .ds-quiet-button { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.625rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); background: var(--panel-inset); border: 1px solid var(--panel-edge); border-radius: 2px; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-quiet-button:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--accent-bright); } .ds-quiet-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent-bright); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-quiet-button:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Preset Chip
components.description: Calibrated survey mode in the 3-up preset row; the latched state spends amber edge + text + faint tint.
components.css: .ds-preset-chip { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.625rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); background: var(--panel-inset); border: 1px solid var(--panel-edge); border-radius: 2px; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.25rem; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-preset-chip:hover { border-color: var(--accent-bright); } .ds-preset-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); background: rgba(255, 181, 71, 0.08); } .ds-preset-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent-bright); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Truth Chip Line
components.description: Mission-strip telemetry line: muted micro-labels separated by graticule-steel slashes — structure, not signal.
components.css: .ds-truth-line { margin: 0; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.3rem 0; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.625rem; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); } .ds-truth-line span + span::before { content: '/'; margin: 0 0.6em; color: var(--graticule); }

components.name: Seed Field
components.description: Typed telemetry: cut-out well, mono 0.875rem, integers only — invalid commits revert and explain.
components.html: <label class="ds-seed-label" for="ds-seed">Seed</label><input id="ds-seed" class="ds-seed-field" type="text" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="off" value="128" />
components.css: .ds-seed-label { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); } .ds-seed-field { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--text); background: var(--panel-inset); border: 1px solid var(--panel-edge); border-radius: 2px; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; } .ds-seed-field:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent-bright); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Gain-Ruler Slider
components.description: Native range dressed as an instrument: 2px steel track with minor ticks, 10×22 amber block thumb.
components.html: <input class="ds-gain-slider" type="range" min="0" max="1" step="0.01" value="0.5" aria-label="Elevation band" />
components.css: .ds-gain-slider { appearance: none; -webkit-appearance: none; width: 100%; min-height: 2.5rem; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-gain-slider::-webkit-slider-runnable-track { height: 2px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(to right, var(--panel-edge) 0 1px, transparent 1px 12.5%) left center / 100% 6px no-repeat, var(--panel-edge); } .ds-gain-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb { -webkit-appearance: none; width: 10px; height: 22px; margin-top: -10px; background: var(--accent); border: 1px solid var(--accent-ink); border-radius: 1px; } .ds-gain-slider::-moz-range-track { height: 2px; background: var(--panel-edge); } .ds-gain-slider::-moz-range-thumb { width: 10px; height: 22px; background: var(--accent); border: 1px solid var(--accent-ink); border-radius: 1px; } .ds-gain-slider:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent-bright); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Rack Module Label
components.description: The telemetry rack's section nomenclature — Capture, Field bands, Survey presets, Acquire, Data out.
components.css: .ds-module-label { margin: 0.9rem 0 0.55rem; padding: 0 1rem; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.625rem; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); }

components.name: Pass-Line with Signal LED
components.description: Map status under the plate: mono line prefixed by an 8×8 amber LED that pulses only while bands acquire.
components.css: .ds-pass-line { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; margin: 0.8rem 0 0; min-height: 1.5em; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--text); } .ds-pass-line::before { content: ''; flex: 0 0 auto; width: 8px; height: 8px; background: var(--accent); } .ds-pass-line.ds-busy::before { animation: ds-led-pulse 1.1s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-led-pulse { 50% { opacity: 0.3; } }

components.name: Raster Plate Frame
components.description: The plate's apparatus: coordinate ruler (graticule majors every 1/8, hairline minors every 1/32), registration brackets, inset well for the 512² composite.
components.css: .ds-plate { position: relative; margin: 0; padding: 30px 10px 10px 36px; background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--panel-edge); border-radius: 3px; } .ds-plate-ruler { position: absolute; top: 7px; left: 36px; right: 10px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding-bottom: 8px; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.625rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: var(--text-muted); background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(to right, var(--graticule) 0 1px, transparent 1px calc(100% / 8)), repeating-linear-gradient(to right, var(--panel-edge) 0 1px, transparent 1px calc(100% / 32)); background-size: 100% 5px; background-position: bottom left; background-repeat: no-repeat; } .ds-plate-mark { position: absolute; width: 11px; height: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); } .ds-tl { top: -1px; left: -1px; border-top: 2px solid; border-left: 2px solid; } .ds-br { bottom: -1px; right: -1px; border-bottom: 2px solid; border-right: 2px solid; } .ds-plate-well { aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; background: var(--panel-inset); font-size: 0; }

components.name: Error Region
components.description: The failure module: readable coral on deep maroon, role=alert, with its own Try-again control that never disables.
components.html: Map generation failed — your settings are preserved
components.css: .ds-error { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.625rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; background: var(--danger-bg); border: 1px solid var(--danger-edge); border-radius: 2px; color: var(--danger-text); font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-error-msg { min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-retry { font: inherit; color: var(--danger-text); background: transparent; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 2px; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-retry:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent-bright); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The app is a ground station receiving procedural terrain. The map is read as a false-color composite acquired in bands — the only luminous, saturated object on the screen — and everything around it is telemetry: ruler ticks, registration marks, mono readouts, labeled modules. The lineage is earth-observation practice (Landsat/Sentinel band composites, mission consoles), and the world exists to refuse the default it was built against: the dark dashboard with a slider sidebar. There is no sidebar; there is one instrument, and the visitor reads it top-to-bottom the way a capture is made — Capture, Field bands, Survey presets, Acquire, Data out.

Depth is structural, not luminous: flat night-navy panels, 1px steel hairlines, and one inset well per module. Exactly one signal color exists — capture amber — and it is rationed to what is live: the readouts, the signal LED, the slider thumbs, the latched preset, focus rings and hover edges, and the Acquire stamp. Structure is never amber; the graticule steel of the rulers, chip separators, and the legend toggle carries the measuring apparatus instead.

Motion belongs to the map. The staged band reveal is the product; chrome settles in 150ms and nothing else moves except the busy LED pulse and a one-shot dice tumble — all disabled under a global prefers-reduced-motion guard. The composite stays pixel-crisp: 512² rendered nearest-neighbor, never smoothed.
keyCharacteristics: One luminous false-color composite; chrome is instrumentation, never decoration
Night-navy ground, ice text, steel hairlines, one capture-amber signal spent only on live things
Archivo speaks (display/UI); Martian Mono measures (every label, readout, and coordinate)
Flat panels + 1px hairlines carry all depth — zero shadows in the chrome
Instrument apparatus: coordinate rulers 0–512, registration brackets, inset wells, gain-ruler sliders
Motion is rationed: the staged reveal owns it; chrome transitions at 150ms; reduced-motion kills all

rules.name: The Amber Economy Rule
rules.body: Amber marks what is live and nothing else: readouts, the LED, slider thumbs, the latched preset, focus rings/hover edges, the Acquire stamp, selection/caret. One amber fill per screen (the stamp). Structure, dividers, and markers are steel; if everything is amber, nothing is being signaled.

rules.name: The Chrome Recedes Rule
rules.body: The map is the only saturated object on screen. Chrome carries no hue beyond navy, steel, ice, amber-as-signal, and the danger family. The 12-color biome palette is product data living inside the composite — chrome never borrows a biome color, and never lends chrome colors to the map.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Archivo speaks; Martian Mono measures. Anything that is a measurement, coordinate, label, or machine caption is Martian Mono. Anything that is a human sentence is Archivo. Never set a numeral that changes in Archivo, never set a sentence in mono.

rules.name: The Reserved Line Rule
rules.body: The pass-line and the probe reading each reserve their height (min-height: 1.5em) before anything is written to them. State text appears and disappears; the plate never shifts.

rules.name: The Pairing Rule
rules.body: The plate and the rack are one instrument: never separate them into pages, never let the row wrap, never stack above 640px. Tuning without seeing is a dashboard; that is the refused world.

rules.name: The Flat Station Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat panels with 1px hairlines. If a future surface seems to need a shadow, it needs a hairline or a tone step instead. The probe halo is not a precedent; it is part of the instrument that reads the map.

dos: Do spend amber only on what is live, and keep exactly one amber fill per screen — the Acquire stamp (The Amber Economy Rule).
Do render every marker, divider, and ruler tick in graticule steel or steel edge; structure is never amber.
Do set every label, numeral, and coordinate in Martian Mono; sentences in Archivo (The Two Voices Rule).
Do keep touch targets ≥ 2.5rem and focus at 3px amber-bright / 2px offset on every interactive element.
Do reserve caption line heights (1.5em) so state text never shifts the plate (The Reserved Line Rule).
Do keep the canvas nearest-neighbor (crisp-edges declared before pixelated) — pixel-crisp is the material.
Do let chrome settle at 150ms ease and stop there; all meaningful motion belongs to the staged reveal, the busy LED pulse, and the one-shot dice tumble, all under the reduced-motion guard.
donts: Don't put a shadow on any chrome surface — depth is tone steps and 1px hairlines (The Flat Station Rule); the probe halo is functional legibility on the map, not elevation.
Don't introduce a second accent hue or any saturated chrome color; the danger family is the only other chroma and it is reserved for failure.
Don't fill quiet buttons on hover — hover spends the amber edge only.
Don't round anything past 3px, pill a control, or circle a signal; signals are square.
Don't replace native sliders, inputs, or the details/summary with custom widgets; nativeness is the accessibility strategy.
Don't rename or reformat the :root tokens --bg, --panel, --accent-bright, --text, --danger-text, --danger-bg — they are test-enforced (src/ui/layout.test.ts) as #rrggbb.
Don't let the map's palette leak into the chrome or the chrome's into the map (The Chrome Recedes Rule).
